UPSC CDS 2 Notification 2026 Released: Your Gateway to a Distinguished Career in Defence!

Aspiring to join the prestigious Indian Armed Forces? The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has officially released the Combined Defence Services (CDS) 2 Notification 2026, opening doors for dedicated individuals to embark on a fulfilling career in the Indian Military Academy (IMA), Indian Naval Academy (INA), Air Force Academy (AFA), and Officers' Training Academy (OTA). This is your comprehensive guide to everything you need to know about CDS 2 2026, from application dates to eligibility and exam details.

The UPSC CDS 2 2026 notification was released on May 20, 2026, announcing 451 vacancies. The online application window is currently active, with the last date to apply being June 9, 2026. The written examination is scheduled for September 13, 2026.

Key Dates for UPSC CDS 2 2026

Mark your calendars! Staying updated with crucial dates is the first step towards a successful application.

✅ Notification Release Date: May 20, 2026

✅ Online Application Start Date: May 20, 2026

✅ Last Date to Apply Online: June 9, 2026 (until 6:00 PM)

✅ Last Date to Pay Application Fee: June 9, 2026

✅ Written Exam Date: September 13, 2026 (Sunday)

✅ Courses Commencing: July 2027 (IMA/INA/AFA) and October 2027 (OTA)

Vacancy Details (451 Posts)

A total of 451 vacancies have been announced for CDS 2 2026 across various academies. This is a significant opportunity for candidates looking to serve the nation.

Specific academy-wise distribution of vacancies will be detailed in the official notification PDF, which candidates are advised to download and review thoroughly.

UPSC CDS 2 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Before applying, it's crucial to ensure you meet the eligibility requirements set by the UPSC. These criteria cover nationality, age limit, educational qualifications, and marital status.

1. Nationality
Candidates must be:
  • A Citizen of India, or
  • A Subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or
  • A Tibetan refugee who came over to India with the intention of permanently settling in India before January 1, 1962, or
  • A person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries (like Pakistan, Sri Lanka, East African countries) with the intention of permanently settling in India.
2. Age Limit (as of specific dates for course commencement)
Age limits vary by academy and are strictly enforced. Unmarried male candidates are generally eligible for IMA, INA, and AFA, while both unmarried male and female candidates can apply for OTA.

For detailed age criteria, refer to the official notification. As a general guide for CDS 2 2026:

  • IMA & INA: Candidates born not earlier than July 2, 2003, and not later than July 1, 2008. (Unmarried males)
  • AFA: Candidates born not earlier than July 2, 2002, and not later than July 1, 2006. (Age relaxation up to 26 years for Commercial Pilot Licence holders).
  • OTA (SSC Men & Women): Candidates born not earlier than July 2, 2001, and not later than July 1, 2007. (Unmarried males and females).
3. Educational Qualification
The minimum educational qualification for CDS 2 2026 is a Graduation Degree from a recognized University. Final-year students are also eligible to apply, provided they submit proof of passing by the stipulated deadline.
  • For IMA & OTA: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized University or equivalent.
  • For INA: Bachelor's degree in Engineering from a recognized University.
  • For AFA: Bachelor's degree from a recognized University (with Physics and Mathematics at 10+2 level) or a Bachelor of Engineering.
4. Marital Status
Generally, only unmarried candidates are eligible. However, for OTA, issueless widows who have not remarried and issueless divorcees who have not remarried are also eligible. Marriage is not permitted during the training period.

How to Apply for UPSC CDS 2 2026

The application process is entirely online and involves a One-Time Registration (OTR) followed by filling out the application form.

Step-by-Step Application Process:
  1. Visit the official UPSC online application portal: upsconline.nic.in.
  2. Complete the 'One-Time Registration (OTR)' if you haven't already. This involves providing basic details and verifying your mobile number and email ID.
  3. Log in using your OTR credentials.
  4. Click on the "Online Application for Various Examination" link and select "CDS 2 Exam 2026".
  5. Fill out the application form with personal, educational, and communication details. Carefully select your academy preferences.
  6. Upload scanned copies of your passport-size photograph, signature, and a valid photo ID proof (e.g., Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID).
  7. Pay the application fee: ₹200 for General/OBC male candidates. Female, SC/ST candidates are exempted from the fee.
  8. Review all the entered details before final submission, as no corrections are typically allowed afterward.
  9. Download and print your application form for future reference.

Candidates are advised to apply well before the last date (June 9, 2026) to avoid any last-minute technical issues and to secure their preferred exam center, which is allotted on a first-apply-first-allot basis.

UPSC CDS 2 2026 Exam Pattern & Syllabus Overview

The CDS examination consists of a written test followed by an SSB Interview and medical examination. The written exam pattern varies slightly depending on the academy.

Exam Pattern Highlights:
  • The exam will be conducted in offline mode (pen and paper) on September 13, 2026.
  • All questions will be objective multiple-choice questions and bilingual (Hindi & English).
  • There is a negative marking of 1/3rd (0.33) marks for each incorrect answer.
Academy Subjects Duration (Each Paper) Max Marks (Each Paper)
IMA, INA, AFA English, General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics 2 Hours 100
OTA (Men & Women) English, General Knowledge 2 Hours 100
Syllabus Overview:

The syllabus for CDS 2 2026 is comprehensive, designed to assess a candidate's general awareness, language proficiency, and analytical skills.

✅ English: Tests understanding of English at the graduate level, including grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, synonyms, antonyms, idioms & phrases, spotting errors, and sentence completion.

✅ General Knowledge: Covers a broad range of topics including Current Affairs, History (Ancient, Medieval, Modern India), Geography, Indian Polity, Economics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Defence-related awards.

✅ Elementary Mathematics (for IMA, INA, AFA only): Includes Arithmetic (Number System, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Time & Work), Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, and Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode).

Prepare for Success!

With the exam scheduled for September 13, 2026, it's time to intensify your preparation. Focus on strengthening your basics, staying updated with current affairs, and practicing with previous year's papers and mock tests. Consistency is key to cracking the CDS examination.

This is a golden opportunity to serve the nation with honor and pride. Ensure you meet all eligibility criteria, submit your application well in advance, and dedicate yourself to thorough preparation. Good luck!
